objective: Freshly preregistered frontier pilot using four previously untested mechanism families, with an independently sourced Binance Vision funding route and 1h representation.
selection_rule: Validation-only; select highest fresh-validation Sharpe among candidates with n>=100, mean>0, PF>1, Sharpe>=0.5. Historian rankings and OOS/holdout are excluded.
deployment_rule: never automatic; requires independent rerun plus explicit human approval
data_route: Binance Vision monthly USD-M Futures 1h klines + monthly fundingRate archives
repair_reason: Initial pilot aborted during acquisition because an auxiliary symbol returned HTTP 404 before any scientific evaluation. R2 retains only BTC/ETH/SOL, the exact symbols required by H16-H19, so no previously observed scientific result is altered or selected.
